content: Delta encoding was disabled in frame F-C3.
claims: The analyzer captured a four-byte sample body for this frame.

sources.text: Protocol analyzer record for frame F-C3. The received options octet is 0x04. Under the attached version-3 header specification, bit zero enables delta encoding when set and disables delta encoding when clear; no other bit controls this feature. The analyzer decodes bit zero as clear and records delta encoding disabled for this frame. The four-byte sample body was captured intact. This record makes no claim about other frames.

content: The recorded sound level was lower in run B than in run A.
claims: Fan speed was held fixed between the two runs.

sources.text: Acoustic notebook, enclosure test T5. Run A recorded 68 dB with the original lining and the microphone 0.5 m from the enclosure. Run B recorded 61 dB after a foam insert was fitted and the microphone was moved to 2 m. Fan speed was held fixed. No run held microphone distance constant while varying the insert, and no separate effect of either change was estimated. The notebook reports the two readings without attributing the difference to a cause.

content: At the final status read, unit H8 still used rising pulse polarity.
claims: The falling-polarity configuration was stored in inactive bank B.

sources.text: Motion-controller configuration trace for unit H8. At boot, active bank A set pulse polarity to rising. A later upload stored a falling-polarity configuration in inactive bank B. The controller reported upload complete but activation pending. The final status read, after that upload, still identifies bank A as active and rising polarity as the effective value. No bank-switch command occurred within the trace.
